text: Eleric Belfoy is a blood elf located at the Solaarian Sunbath in Eversong Woods.
Eleyna Duskbreeze is a night elf herbalism trainer located in Aldrassil in .
Onyx Clutchwarden is a green drakonid who is defending green dragon eggs from Primalist attack in the Ruby Life Pools.
Emperor's Favor is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Legacy of Wisdom.

Eminent Earthshaper is a dwarf located in the Quarry of Infusion in the Vault of the Incarnates. She is leading the ritual to summon Terros, but upon approach, the ritual is disrupted. Terros is summoned too early, and she is killed.
Emielle is a human located at the Outer Banks in Founder's Point.
Emptiness is a Devourer demon hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Soul Glutton.
Enchanter Alan'ah is a blood elf who sometimes represents the Magisters at Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods.
Endless Wrath is a Templar paladin hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Sanctification.
Endless Draught is a Master of Harmony hero talent for monks.
Enduring Torment is a Scarred hero talent for demon hunters.
Energy Compression is an Archon priest hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Sustained Potency.
Enkindle is a Flameshaper evoker hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Expanded Lungs.
Entangling Vortex is a Wildstalker hero talent for druids. It is an exclusive choice node with Flower Walk.
Entropic Rift is a Voidweaver priest hero talent. It is only available to Discipline priests; Shadow priests get Void Torrent instead.
Enslaved Red Dragon is a monster ally card depicting an enslaved red dragon from the Betrayal of the Guardian set.
Eraneth is a night elf located in Gladiator's Refuge in Valdrakken.
Esana was a night elf located in Lunarfall during development.
Escalation is an Aldrachi Reaver hero talent for demon hunters.
Ereria Galesinger is a night elf located in the Viridescent Thicket in Amirdrassil.
Eredar Deathspeaker is a man'ari eredar located in the Lost Temple on the Broken Shore during The Search for the Highlord.
Eternal Sun was a Herald of the Sun paladin hero talent. It was an exclusive choice node with Lingering Radiance.
Eternal Servitude is a Soul Harvester warlock hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Gorefiend's Resolve.
Ethereal Cloak is a Deathstalker rogue hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Bait and Switch
Eternal Sanctity is a Holy priest talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Divinity.
Evasive Action is an Aldrachi Reaver hero talent for demon hunters. It is an exclusive choice node with Unhindered Assault.
Etna Blayze is an Arathi and the current leader of the Priory of the Sacred Flame in Hallowfall.

Etries was a member of the Council of Oracles associated with the Architects, one of the four aspects of K'areshi society. She also held membership among the Ravel. When High Priest Salhadaar transferred leadership of the Ravel to Locus-Walker, Etries protested against it but was won over by Locus-Walker's assurances that his work was for the good of K'aresh and its people.
Excoriation is a Lightsmith paladin hero talent. It shares a choice node with Fear No Evil (paladin hero talent).
Exacerbating Wounds is a Druid of the Claw druid hero talent.
Exergy is a Havoc demon hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Inertia.
Expansiveness is a Keeper of the Grove hero talent for druids.
Expanded Lungs is a Flameshaper evoker hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Enkindle.
Executioner Lynthelma was a blood elf located in the Highland Forest in the Twilight Highlands.
Expelling Shield is a Deathbringer hero talent for death knights. It is an exclusive choice node with Death's Messenger.
Exterminate is a Deathbringer hero talent for death knights.
Explosive Powder is a hunter PvP talent, available at level 50.
Eyes Closed is a Sentinel hero talent for hunters. It is an exclusive choice node with Sentinel Watch.

Ezzorak is a void dragon located on the Isle of Quel'Danas when the Devouring Host invaded it. Once a red dragon, he and his brother Vaelgor were corrupted into void dragons. They can be found laying siege to Parhelion Plaza. The two were eventually slain within the Voidspire.

Farmer Bruvk is an orc located in Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands. When ogres and kobolds raided the farm, he initially thought the attack was the Alliance doing and fled with peons from the field. He was soon found by Thrall and Jaina Proudmoore, and told them about the leader of the attack, Runk. Having spent the entire harvest cultivating pumpkins, he went with adventurers back to the field to gather his pumpkings.
Fanorran Stilloak is a night elf mining trainer located at the base of Aldrassil in .
Fatebender is an Oracle hero talent for priests. It is an exclusive choice node with Perfect Vision.
Farstrider Helia was a blood elf located in the elven camp in the Twilight Highlands.
Farstrider Kadira is a blood elf located in Lightbloom Lash'Ra in Eversong Woods.
Farstrider Cerath is a blood elf located in Lightbloom Lash'Ra in Eversong Woods.
Farstrider Norella is a blood elf located in Lightbloom Lash'Ra in Eversong Woods.
Fay Stouthammer is a dwarf located in Dun Morogh during Brewfest.
Fel-Blessed Highborne is a night elf located in the Passage of Time in Thaldraszus.

Fenistrasza was a red dragon who died fighting the djaradin named Tarjin the Blind by holding her in a volcano for three days straight. Her skull would later be taken by the adventurers and given to the Dragonscale Expedition.

Fently is a human who traveled with the Ashvane Trading Company expedition on the Maiden's Whisper to the Siren Isle. He was described as a brute. He found Turbulent Fragments and, wanting to keep them for himself, hid them across the isle.
Fierce Followthrough is a Slayer hero talent for warriors. It is an exclusive choice node with Opportunist.
Fire Familiar is an Fire spirit summoned by Glyph of Elemental Familiars and Raging Elemental Stone.
First Mate Kip is a human found in the Scarlet Enclave raid.
Flamebound is a Scarred demon hunter hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Student of Suffering.
Flamebringer Kelris is an orc found at Firewatch Ridge in the during the Blackrock Eruption event.
Flamebreak is a Survival hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Shrapnel Bomb.
Flame Keeper Rizzli is a hero card from the Twilight of the Dragons set.
Flaming Megafan is a human located in the Liberation of Undermine. He needs to be spoken to in order to accomplish the Flarendo's Biggest Fan achievement.
Flaura Maryt is a blood elf located at the Solaarian Sunbath in Eversong Woods.
Flickerstrike is a Trickster rogue hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Thousand Cuts.
Fleuric is a human found in the smaller secondary tower of Karazhan in . He allows warlocks who speak who him while in their Metamorphosis (warlock rune) form to battle with Xalus Nihilus.
Fletcher Swiftwind is a blood elf who sometimes represents the Farstriders at Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods.
Flower Walk is a Wildstalker hero talent for druids. It is an exclusive choice node with Entangling Vortex.
Florius is a green dragon located in in Agol'watha in the during Nightmare Incursions.
Flowing Spirit is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Battle Meditation.
Flowing Wisdom is a Conduit of the Celestials monk hero talent.
Forewarning is a Lightsmith paladin hero talent. It shares a choice node with Divine Inspiration.

Foreman Uzjax is a member of the Machine Speakers. While initially a firm believer of High Speaker Eirich, he grew disillusioned with his leadership and aided Speaker Brinthe in deposing the corrupted High Speaker. At some point he commanded a group of Horde champions in a conflict against Ruffious' Alliance ones over the resources of Deephaul Ravine. After the Awakening Machine was restored by Magni Bronzebeard, Uzjax became a guide for newly awakened earthen, alongside Dawn, helping them navigate the process of awakening and preparing them for the outside world.
Forgotten Hero is a human vendor located at Tabetha's Farm in Dustwallow Marsh during Radiant Echoes. He is a projection of Reginald Windsor.
Frenzied Bloodthirst is a San'layn death knight hero talent.
Freddie Threads is a human located at the Infinite Bazaar during Legion Remix. He sells cloak ensembles.
Frenzied Doomguard is a monster ally card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
Frightened Lunarwing is a faerie dragon located in Lunarwing Shallows in Val'sharah. It is held rooted by the Thistleleaf Bully.
Frigid Hunger is a Deathbringer hero talent for death knights.
Frigid Focus is a Frost mage talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Splintering Ray.
Frizzlight is a monster ally card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
Frostbane is a Frost death knight talent. When triggered, it replaces Frost Strike with Frostbane.
Furious Assault is a Pack Leader hero talent for hunters. It is an exclusive choice node with Beast of Opportunity.

Galvus Ironhammer is a dwarf located at the Gala of Gifts by the Stormwind Gate in Elwynn Forest during Love is in the Air. Players who donate enough gold to him will earn the Support Your Local Artisans achievement. As thanks for the gold donations, players will receive a letter a few minutes later with a Bundle of Love Tokens containing 5-10x Love Token. Over the course of the event, the gold piles surrounding Galvus grow ever larger.
Galiel is a human found outside the Caverns of Time in Tanaris during the Bronze Celebration.
Garketh Anvilcrack is a Mag'har orc found talking to Modaln outside the Burning Anvil in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.
Gefell is a human found upstairs from the dining hall in when a rogue enters the dungeon solo. He seems to be one of 's guards.
Gemela is a human found in the dining hall in when a rogue enters the dungeon solo.

Gehl Harrowtongue is a Forsaken member of the Twilight's Blade who oversees the initiation of Twilight Blade's acolytes. He is the vice cult leader in charge of the Twilight's Blade training grounds. Gehl happened upon what appeared to be a new recruit (actually an adventurer in disguise) and, noticing they hadn't obtained a tabard, sent them to train with the other novices while he moved further into Dunwald Ruins. After the "recruit" completed their training, Gehl directed them to join an initiation ceremony where a projection of the Twilight's Blade leader, Mor'duun, would speak. The adventurer sabotaged the ceremony, regrouped with Magister Umbric, then killed several cultists and finall

General Vaelisia Steelstrike is the leader of the Hallowfall Arathi and commander of their army. Having been placed in charge of the Hallowfall Expedition by the Emperor of the Arathi, her unyielding will has seen her people through the darkest of times.

General Ottomar is an earthen character in "The Rivals", a play performed by the theater group at the Proscenium on the Isle of Dorn. According to the play he was once one of Dornic's top generals, alongside General Emmerich, their two companies being the fiercest in Khaz Algar. When Dornic decided he only needed one general he told his generals to decide among themselves who would be decommissioned. The generals fought among each other till only Ottomar and Emmerich were left. While Emmerich was stronger than Ottomar physically, Ottomar had the advantage when it came to leadership and the loyalty of his troops and so in the end he was triumphant and became the only general of the earthen fo

General Emmerich is an earthen character in "The Rivals", a play performed by the theater group at the Proscenium on the Isle of Dorn. According to the play he was once one of Dornic's top generals, alongside General Ottomar, their two companies being the fiercest in Khaz Algar. When Dornic decided he only needed one general he told his generals to decide among themselves who would be decommissioned. The generals fought among each other till only Emmerich and Ottomar were left. While Emmerich was stronger than Ottomar physically, Ottomar had the advantage when it came to leadership and the loyalty of his troops and so in the end Emmerich lost.
Geologist Om'tik is a broker and member of Cartel Om and the K'aresh Trust located in Eco-Dome: Primus.
Gerig Beledel is a blood elf located at the Solaarian Sunbath in Eversong Woods.
Gez'her was a merchant-captain of Ma'nussa's market guild who held membership in the Ravel. He rarely spoke at meetings.
Ghostly Charger is a monster ally card from the Betrayal of the Guardian set. Redeeming the loot card variant awards the mount.
Ghoulmaster Kalisa is a hero card from the Throne of the Tides set.

Giles Flintridge was the younger brother of Tilloa Flintridge, the son of a human noble of Stormwind, and a student to Stalvan Mistmantle. He was murdered the same night that Stalvan took his revenge.
Glacial Bulwark is a Frost mage talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Cold Snap.

Sister Goldskimmer is a goblin priest trainer first seen at the entrance to the KTC Headquarters on Kezan. She is later seen at multiple points on the Lost Isles, and finally at the entrance to the inn in Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara. She demonstrates the goblin priest mindset by constantly asking for tithes, and while on Kezan she is always seen standing on top of a large pile of gold. In Undermine, now called Mother Goldskimmer, she ran her own sewer-side chapel in Hovel Hill, where she was attended by her accountant Grenda and her altar oaf Grup. Goldskimmer was a part of the Vanguard of the Light summoned to defend the Sunwell from Xal'atath. After the Devouring Host's initial assault wa

Good Guy Ray is a dwarf of Keg Leg's Crew located in Brew Bay in the Arathi Highlands during Plunderstorm. Good Guy Ray is being towed around the water by a Silver Tidestallion seahorse mount. Fortunately (or unfortunately), he cannot die since running out of breath underwater does not kill the player in the lobby. He is thus caught in an endless cycle of what is essentially waterboarding. We must imagine Good Guy Ray happy.
Gorebound Fortitude is a Soul Harvester warlock hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Friends in Dark Places (warlock hero talent).

Gorgrum Kegfist is an orc located next to the center stage of the Brewfest Grounds in Durotar during Brewfest. Players must speak with him to participate in the Brewfest Banquet at the top of the hour.
Grand Overspinner Antourix is a nerubian sage located in Rak-Ahat in Azj-Kahet.
Grand Gluttony is a kobyss located in the Salien Gutters in Azj-Kahet and the leader of the kobyss tribe found in there.

Grandmaster Jakkus is an infinite dragon in pandaren visage vendor located at Infinite Bazaars during the WoW Remix events. At Halfhill Market in Valley of the Four Winds, he starts The Story of Noodles. He sells recolors of Trading Post armor and ensembles and will periodically don different class equipment.
Gravity Lapse is a Sunfury hero talent for mages. It is an exclusive choice node with Lessons in Debilitation.
Grave Mastery is an Unholy death knight talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Plague Mastery.
Grayson Steelworth is a hero card from the War of the Elements set.
Griminoth was a frost proto-dragon who accompanied Fyrakk to parley with the Dragon Aspects. He was ordered by Fyrakk to present the titan-forged egg-carrier to Alexstrasza.
Grimkel is a dwarf found with Vorkan Thunderbrow outside the Caverns of Time in Tanaris during the Bronze Celebration.
Grimlash Thornclaw is an orc located in Durotar during Brewfest.
Grodd Eagermaul is an orc. Based on his title, he would likely have appeared in Valdrakken during Who Are You?.

Grok'lo Mok'lo is an orc found next to Brother Luctus at the Light's Hope Chapel in the . He also appears in the Ruins of Eldarath, , , , Gadgetzan, , and Everlook in . He used to be an Orgrimmar grunt alongside Kug Softjaw. They guarded the Gates of Orgrimmar together, where Kug used to be friendly and understanding, while Grok'lo was violent.
Gritta Brewstone is a dwarf located by the center stage of the Brewfest Grounds in Dun Morogh. Players must speak with her to participate in the Brewfest Banquet at the top of the hour.
Gronthul is a Mag'har orc decor vendor located in the Common in Razorwind Shores.
Grugimdern is a dwarf located in the . Druids can speak to him to acquire a Marshroom, which is required to find Vodyanoi.
Gru'ark is a drunken orc found outside Borstan's Firepit in Orgrimmar. After talking to Zamja, he can be challenged to a fight to get the Rune of Frenzied Assault for warriors.
Grove's Inspiration is a Keeper of the Grove hero talent for druids. It is an exclusive choice node with Potent Enchantments.
Guffren Boulderbeard was a dwarf found at Southshore in the .
Gusseon Mistley is a human located upstairs in Lion's Pride Inn in Elwynn Forest.

Guzu was a legendary character in who was killed in the Sunken Temple. While engaged in battle with Weaver, Guzu was knocked back by and thrown directly into the center hole of the Pit of Sacrifice, ultimately falling to his demise. He attempted to drink a Noggenfogger Elixir for a chance of the slow fall buff, but alas luck was not on his side. Blizzard added Guzu's corpse, same armor and all, to the Pit of Refuse in .

Gurnot is a member of the Stormriders. He was first encountered patrolling in Dhar Durgaz where he served as a guard. Later, he showed up in Dhar Oztan, feeling a compulsion to come to the place. After Lufsela managed to summon new stormrooks at the peak of Dhar Oztan, Gurnot ended up bonding with one of them, which he named Veytar. He then joined the Stormriders and was trained in aerial maneuvers by Kurdran Wildhammer. Soon after he took part in the battle against the Colossal Titan Construct that activated when the earthen of Khaz Algar renounced the Edicts. After that, he can be encountered back in Dhar Oztan, now the home of the Stormriders once again, talking to his fellow Stormriders
Haleth Turnwater is a blood elf located at the Common in Razorwind Shores. Next to him is a Dye Station.
Halenthos Brightstride is a blood elf located in the Filthy Animal in Dalaran.
Hanesel is a blood elf located at the Solaarian Sunbath in Eversong Woods.
Happy Camper is a dwarf located at the Gates of Ironforge in Dun Morogh and just outside Orgrimmar in Durotar.
Hardened Scales is a Scalecommander hero talent for evokers. It is an exclusive choice node with Menacing Presence.
Harmonic Gambit is a Master of Harmony monk hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Purified Spirit.
Harbinger Sefu is a monster ally card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
Harmonious Constitution is a Wildstalker hero talent for druids. It is an exclusive choice node with Bond with Nature.
Hatefury Rituals is a Hellcaller warlock hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Bleakheart Tactics.
Headshot is a Marksmanship hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Deadeye (hunter talent).
Healing Specialization is a druid, mage, paladin, priest, and shaman rune for rings. It is learned from Rune of Healing Specialization.
Heightened Alteration is an Archon priest hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Word of Supremacy.
Henria Derth was a dwarf who was found in Dun Morogh during the original beta.
Hevo'myk is a nerubian sage located at Siegehold in Azj-Kahet.

Herrkrop is a dead orc located at Wavestrider Beach north of the Caverns of Time in Tanaris during the Bronze Celebration. Before heading north, he left behind an Abandoned Beach Chair at Southbreak Shore. His corpse was hidden as a Buried Object but can be revealed with the Torch of Pyrreth. He was killed by Y'lliya Xennin, who framed Scrapes as the murderer.
High Interrogator Kilandrelle is a high elf from the Warlands located in Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus during Time Rifts.
High Impact is a Shado-Pan hero talent for monks. It is an exclusive choice node with Pride of Pandaria.
High Guardian Malosun is a hero card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
High Oracle Naseem is a monster ally card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
High Magus Olvek is a hero card from the Throne of the Tides set.
High Priestess Neeri is a hero card from the Throne of the Tides set.
Highbank Demolitionist is a dwarf located in the Twilight Highlands.
Highland Lion is a monster ally card depicting a lion from the Betrayal of the Guardian set.
Hilda Thornwood is a human located upstairs in Lion's Pride Inn in Elwynn Forest.
Hilda Hellforge is a Dark Iron dwarf located outside the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

Holt is a human located in Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands. He and his brothers had been serving the Syndicate as bandits for years. During the unrest in the Highlands, the new Syndicate leader sent the Olsons on a mission for the Red Dawn, which Barclay attributed to the leader's attempt to get rid of them. Holt was against working with the Red Dawn. They could choose from two assignments: either infiltrate Hammerfall or plant evidence in Witherbark Village and frame the Horde. They chose the latter, but the mission went awry; the brothers, except Barclay, were captured by the Witherbark trolls, while Barclay managed to escape and negotiate help. Horsemen's Aid is a Rider of the Apocalypse hero talent for death knights. It is an exclusive choice node with Pact of the Apocalypse.
Hungering Thirst is a Rider of the Apocalypse death knight hero talent.
Human Operative is an ally card depicting a human operative of SI:7 from the Betrayal of the Guardian set.
Human Sniper is an ally card depicting a human sniper from the Betrayal of the Guardian set.
Hunker Down is a Protection warrior talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Spellbreaker (warrior talent).
Human Darkweaver is an ally card depicting a human priest from the Betrayal of the Guardian set.
Human Knight is an ally card depicting a human knight from the Betrayal of the Guardian set.
Human Peasant is an ally card depicting a human peasant from the Betrayal of the Guardian set.
Hurricane's Vault is a Windwalker monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Airborne Rhythm.
Huntsman Gorwal is a hero card from the War of the Elements set.

Illari Duskfeather is a night elf found on the eastern coast of the . There is a boat near the Thandol Span that can be used to reach her. She doesn't like the Alliance, and manipulated Horde marauders such as Tokal to kill human and dwarf marshals.
Illhoof's Design is a Hellcaller warlock hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Zevrim's Resilience.
Idoral Starstrike is a night elf located in the Viridescent Thicket in Amirdrassil.
Ignition Burst is a Fire mage PvP talent, available at Level 40.
Im'bunata is a water spirit in the shape of a timbertooth located in Imbu in the Azure Span. It is the guardian spirit of the local river.
Ilyarius Stormheart is a night elf found with his cronies in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream.
Imbued Warding is a Frostfire hero talent for mages. It is an exclusive choice node with Meltdown (mage hero talent).
Illumine is a Herald of the Sun paladin hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Will of the Dawn.
Ilyssa Darksorrow is a night elf located in the Wastes of K'aresh in the Manaforge Omega. She is one of The Soul Hunters.
Implant is a Wildstalker hero talent for druids. It is an exclusive choice node with Twin Sprouts.
Improved Soul Rending is a Scarred hero talent for demon hunters. It is an exclusive choice node with Set Fire to the Pain.
Improved Streamline is a Marksmanship hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Focused Aim.
Improved Voidform is a Shadow priest talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Ancient Madness.
Incinerator Gar'im is an orc warlock found in Render's Valley in the .
Incisive Blade is an Aldrachi Reaver hero talent for demon hunters.
Incorruptible Spirit is an Aldrachi Reaver hero talent for demon hunters. It is an exclusive choice node with Army Unto Oneself.
Incessant Screams is an Archon hero talent for priests. It is an exclusive choice node with Shock Pulse.
Infernal Vitality is a Diabolist warlock hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Infernal Bulwark.
Infernal Bulwark is a Diabolist warlock hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Infernal Vitality.
Infernal Bolt is a granted by the Secrets of the Coven hero talent.
Inexorable March is a Fatebound rogue hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Death's Arrival.
Inevitabile End is a Fatebound rogue hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Destiny Defined.
Ineilian Crimsonpost is a blood elf located in Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.
Inner Compass is a Conduit of the Celestials monk hero talent.
Initiator's Edge is a Shado-Pan monk hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Combat Stance.
Inge Brightview is a dwarf found at the Library in Ironforge.
Inquisitor Jociphine is a human found at the Scarlet Base Camp in the . She advises the adventurers on how to infiltrate Tyr's Hand.
Inscrutable Ore is a guaranteed drop the first time a character mines a Desolate Deposit on K'aresh.
Instructor Aurelion is a blood elf located at Thuron's Livery at Eversong Woods.

Instructor Valtheras is a blood elf located in the tower at Sunstrider Rise on the Isle of Quel'Danas during the assault by the Devouring Host. He is keeping the Quel'Danas Students safe with the help of Calia Menethil.
Instructor Felagos is a night elf located with a few Nar'thalas Students at the shore north of Nar'thalas Academy in Azsuna. They are discussing a contained Doomblade Overseer that later breaks free.
Invoked Nightmare is a Shadow priest talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Misery (priest talent).
Isadora Nevins is a human child located in Camp Nowhere in the Azure Span.
Isilwen Starforge is a blood elf located in Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.
Jade Sanctuary is a Conduit of the Celestials monk hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Niuzao's Protection.
Jadefire Fists is a Windwalker monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Jadefire Stomp.

Jadia was a high elf member of the Farstriders. During the burning of Quel'Thalas, Windrunner Village came under attack from the Old Horde and their Amani troll allies. They slaughtered most of the elves there, including Jadia. After the Horde retreated, Sylvanas Windrunner arrived and discovered the dead.
Jadefire Teachings is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Rushing Wind Kick.
Izaik Kadarov is a human located outside the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. Next to him is a trophy bear.
Izzia Alor is a blood elf located at the Solaarian Sunbath in Eversong Woods.
Jamniss Treemender is a night elf druid located in during Nightmare Incursions.
Jalgon Stoutburn is a Dark Iron dwarf located in a Mysterious Cave in Zaralek Cavern.
Jarg Riverbender is a blood elf located in the Cragthorn Highlands in Razorwind Shores.
Jeff is a human located at the Entrance Portal in Founder's Point.
Jendry Clockson is a human located southeast of Town Center in Founder's Point. He sells donuts.
Jerem Nado is a blood elf located at the Solaarian Sunbath in Eversong Woods.
Jirri is a petite and usually smiling high elf and a noteworthy member of the Farstriders.
Jorvan Longmoor is a human located at the Town Center on Founder's Point. He can be found with four Workers. His ancestors built the first houses on Founder's Point.
Jon Brightman is a blood elf located at the Brightwing Estate in Eversong Woods. He is sitting on one of the floating platforms with Lynne Brightman and Rhett.
Josephine Carson is a human hunter trainer located in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.
Juddson Rakes is a blood elf found outside the Caverns of Time in Tanaris during the Bronze Celebration. He is seen speaking with Ellanoir and Duryllin.

Junni Steelpass is a dwarf located in the town of Kharanos in . She will trade Monster Hunter's First Rune Fragment, Monster Hunter's Second Rune Fragment, and Monster Hunter's Third Rune Fragment to warriors in exchange for Pristine Trogg Heart, Severed Troll Head, and Severed Wendigo Paw, respectively.
Just Warming Up is an Arms warrior talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Broad Strokes.
Kajind is an orc found in a cave on the Forlorn Ridge in . He used to be champion of the Thunderdrome, Gadgetzan's arena, but retired.
Kaliel Solaar is a blood elf located at the Solaarian Sunbath in Eversong Woods.
Kailia Delan is a blood elf located near Hanesel at the Solaarian Sunbath in Eversong Woods.
Kaine is a void elf located in Windrunner Village in Eversong Woods.

Karn Goreshot is an orc hunter located by Lake Sunspring in Nagrand. He used to be a hunter in the Nesingwary Safari, is friends with Aurora Vabsley, and made acquaintance with Laverne Cameron at the Gala of Gifts.
Karazhan Concubine is a monster ally card from the Betrayal of the Guardian set depicting one of the concubines found in Karazhan.

Karga Bloodfury is a Mag'har orc found in Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands. She serves in Hammerfall as an outrider. When Refuge Point was attacked, Karga noticed it burning and rode in to help. She found and rescued Vikki Lonsav and a group of Refuge Pointe Civilians and stood guard alongside them outside of the settlement when Faerin Lothar and an adventurer found them as they had been on their way to Hammerfall to find Danath Trollbane. Karga was initially suspicious of them, but Faerin surrendered to her. Karga explained the problems the Horde had had back in their settlements, and now she understood that the Alliance was targeted as well. The attackers of Pointe were from the Scarl
Karazhanataur is a tauren during the PTR where he likely provided Karazhan gear for free.

Kazzak is a battle-hardened doomlord and commander of Burning Legion forces. After the Third War, he remained on Azeroth in the Blasted Lands as Lord Kazzak, and later took part in the reopening of the Dark Portal, marking the beginning of the invasion of Outland. Promoted to Doom Lord Kazzak, he was defeated on Outland, but returned as Supreme Lord Kazzak in the war in Draenor.
Katsarah is a green dragon found in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream.
Keen Engagement is an Aldrachi Reaver hero talent for demon hunters. It is an exclusive choice node with Preemptive Strike (demon hunter hero talent).

Kralla Earthstorm is an orc located in the Road Warrior in Gadgetzan in Tanaris along with Blue and her Warband. She fights his evil version outside the town.

Kothilde is the leader of the Stormrangers. She spent many centuries as a Stonebound miner and was first encountered in Freywold Village. Some time after she showed up in Dhar Oztan, feeling a compulsion to go there for an unknown reason. After Lufsela managed to summon new stormrooks at the peak of Dhar Oztan, Kothilde ended up bonding with one of them, which she named Troumer. She became a Stormrider and was trained in aerial maneuvers by Kurdran Wildhammer. Later she took part in the battle against the Colossal Titan Construct that activated when the earthen of Khaz Algar renounced the Edicts.
